business_summary: Shingakukai Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the education-related, sports, real estate, and fund management businesses in Japan. The company provides group and individual tutoring; and produces and sells educational materials. It is also involved in the operation of sports club; ownership, buying and selling/leasing, management, and cleaning of real estate; and management and administration of securities. The company was formerly known as Shingakukai Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shingakukai Holdings Co.,Ltd. in October 2017. Shingakukai Holdings Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Sapporo, Japan.
